# opnsense_haproxy_user (Data Source)

HAProxy users (**Services ▸ HAProxy ▸ Settings ▸ Advanced ▸ Users**, plugin `os-haproxy`).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) UUID of the user.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Description for this user.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable this user.
- `name` (String) Name to identify this user.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Both encrypted and unencrypted passwords can be used. Never returned by OPNsense, always null.
